physics-killer-08.title: Thermal Expansion and Heat Capacity
physics-killer-08.goal: Analyze the principles of Thermal Expansion and Heat Capacity and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-08.material: Muon yakagadzirwa mumhepo yepamusoro yePasi inouya yakatwasuka kuenda kumusoro nokumhanya $0.8c$. Kukwirira kwenzvimbo yokugadzirwa kubva paPasi (kubva pasi) ndi $800\,\mathrm{m}$, uye hupenyu hwepakati hwakayerwa muframe yekuzorora yemuon ndi $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Kana $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wechinhambwe kubva panzvimbo yokugadzirwa kusvika pasi sezvinoonekwa muframe yekuzorora yemuon nenguva inotorwa nemuon kupfuura chinhambwe ichocho zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Muon yakagadzirwa mumhepo yepamusoro yePasi inouya yakatwasuka kuenda kumusoro nokumhanya $0.8c$. Kukwirira kwenzvimbo yokugadzirwa kubva paPasi (kubva pasi) ndi $800\,\mathrm{m}$, uye hupenyu hwepakati hwakayerwa muframe yekuzorora yemuon ndi $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Kana $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wechinhambwe kubva panzvimbo yokugadzirwa kusvika pasi sezvinoonekwa muframe yekuzorora yemuon nenguva inotorwa nemuon kupfuura chinhambwe ichocho zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-08.s.s1.explain: $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.8^2}=5/3$. Length contraction: $L=L_0/\gamma=800\cdot\dfrac35=480\,\mathrm{m}$. Nguva $t=\dfrac{L}{v}=\dfrac{480}{0.8\cdot3\times10^8}=2.0\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{s}=2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Izvi zvakaenzana nehupenyu hwemuon hwakakosha. Muongorori wepaPasi anotsanangura chiitiko chimwe chete nokuwedzera kwenguva (time dilation): $\Delta t=\dfrac{800}{0.8c}=3.3\,\mu\mathrm{s}=\gamma\cdot2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Kuwedzera kunopa $1333\,\mathrm{m}$ (nhema ①), kuwedzera $\gamma$ pachinzvimbo che $v/c$ kunopa $640\,\mathrm{m}$ (nhema ②), kusatarisa kupfupisa ndiyo nhema ④.
